title: On the quotient matrix and its distinct eigenvalues
summary: Let $M$ be an $n\times n$ matrix partitioned into blocks according to a partition $P=\{C_{1},\dots,C_{\ell}\}$ of its index set, and let $Q$ be the corresponding equitable quotient. We study when $Q$ contains every distinct eigenvalue of $M$, so that the distinct spectral data of a large structured matrix can be recovered from a lower-order quotient. We first correct the distinction between a coarsest equitable partition and a minimum-order quotient that captures all distinct eigenvalues.
